subject: Level-change redaction playbook and slot substitution — write-up gaps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Level-change redaction playbook and slot substitution — write-up gaps

Hi Marissa / Lauren,

Attached is the current draft write-up for IR-324 and a preliminary conflict matrix. Two things I need help with this week:

1) Redaction guidance: There are three sections (client names in prior projects, a vendor escalation timeline, and one named reference) that Legal/People ops flagged as PII-sensitive. Can we run a pass to create a safe-to-share version for the committee? I sketched inline comments but would like a short playbook (one-pager) we can reuse for other write-ups.

2) Committee slot: Our originally scheduled slot (May 4) looks full; Marissa, per your calendar there may be a conflicting investor cadence. If we can't get the May 4 panel, can we swap with another candidate in the May 11 window? If so I want to lock a substitution plan now so we can notify the affected advocates and update blackout rules.

Attachments: IR-324_draft_writeup_v0.9.docx; conflict_matrix_IR-324.xlsx; redaction_guidance_playbook_v1.pdf

Next steps I propose: short redaction playbook (one page) + an edits pass on the write-up by EOD Thursday; Marissa to check committee seat availability and propose swap if needed.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sarah Moss <sarah.moss@peopleops-consultants.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Level-change redaction playbook and slot substitution — write-up gaps

Thanks Irene — reviewing now. Quick notes:

- Redaction: I like the playbook idea. Sarah (copied) can draft a 1-page template based on the redaction_guidance_playbook_v1.pdf and our SOC2-friendly patterns. Sarah, can you produce a first pass by Tue?

- Slot swap: May 4 is indeed tight. We have a senior PM (IR-327) blocked for May 11 and their advocate is flexible. If we can move IR-324 to May 11, we should:
  * notify advocates by next Wednesday
  * update blackout for evidence collection to avoid overlaps

- Write-up edits: I left inline suggestions in the doc (track changes off; comments only). Main gap is stronger outcomes evidence for Q3 — can Aditya supply the missing metric snapshots? (see bullets in the doc).

Attaching a quick calendar note: before we do anything public, we should confirm Legal is comfortable with the anonymization level. I can reach out if you'd like — or Sarah can coordinate with People Ops Legal.

—Marissa

Attachment referenced: conflict_matrix_IR-324.xlsx (updated column: proposed_swap->May11)

Date: 2027-04-02T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Level-change redaction playbook and slot substitution — write-up gaps

Looping in Stephanie to confirm advocate availability and Talent Ops for logistics. Quick status update from my side:

- I confirmed with the May 11 slate lead; they can accept IR-324 in exchange for IR-327 as Marissa suggested. I've tentatively reserved the slot pending Legal sign-off on redactions.

- Redaction specifics: please follow these minimums for the committee copy:
  1) Replace customer names with "Customer A/B" where the narrative does not materially change.
  2) Collapse vendor timeline details to quarter-level (Q2 2026) and remove individual rep names.
  3) For the cited escalation note, include a 1-sentence sanitized summary and attach a sealed appendix (people-only) for committee reviewers who have signed NDA.

- Aditya: can you upload the Q3 metric snapshots (CSV or screenshots) to the Drive link Irene shared by EOD Thursday? That will let us finalize the outcomes section.

Irene/Marissa: once Legal confirms the redaction playbook (Sarah), I will:
  * finalize the swap in the calendar
  * send a short notification to advocates and the candidate with new blackout dates
  * provision the sealed appendix access for committee reviewers only

—Lauren
Product People Partner
